incidents.name: unverified_0x452E25 unauthenticated uniswapV3SwapCallback
incidents.notes: The contract's uniswapV3SwapCallback() paid out the requested amount to msg.sender without verifying that the caller was a genuine Uniswap V3 pool, so a direct call with a fabricated delta and token address transferred 27.3 WETH out.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x452E253EeB3Bb16e40337D647c01b6c910Aa84B3 created 2024-06-26T08:25:59Z by 0x0e36ea265ee9317c2ad274a987c2c0f337175955, not the attack-tx sender 0xabee16e74dd268105f166c27a847edc2b8e7cc4e; unverified, no EIP-1967 events, 6.8 days old. ~27 ETH at a July 2024 ETH price near $3,300 is roughly $89k. Loss converted at the incident timestamp: 27 ETH x $3,370.47 (DefiLlama historical ETH price) = $91,003.
